What is your return policy?: You can return any unworn items within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Please keep the receipt!
How long does shipping take?: Standard shipping usually takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days.
Do you ship internationally?: Yes, we ship worldwide! International shipping usually takes 7-14 business days.
How can I track my order?: Once your order ships, we will email you a tracking link. You can also find it in your account dashboard.
What payment methods do you accept?: We accept Visa, MasterCard, PayPal, and Apple Pay.
Can I change my order after placing it?: We process orders very quickly! You have a 1-hour window to cancel or change your order by contacting support.
Do you offer student discounts?: Yes! Register with your student email address to receive a 10% discount code.
